messages:
Zoe Chen: Hey team — Zoe here, started today. Quick summary: I enrolled a passkey via Okta on my phone, 1Password invite accepted, but I can't SSH to the bastion (Permission denied), and I don't see the eng Drive folder. Who should I ping for each?
sarah-it: welcome Zoe! Ping here. For Okta Device Trust, do you see a 'Device not compliant' or 'Enroll a passkey' banner when you log into okta.redwood.com?
Zoe Chen: I saw the enroll prompt and completed the passkey flow. Okta web login works, but `ssh git@bastion.redwood` fails with "Permission denied (publickey)". I also only see a personal drive, not the team folder mentioned in the onboarding doc.
bryan-eng: hey — SSH to bastion requires a registered public SSH key in your Okta profile (we sync ssh keys from Okta -> ssh-provisioner). Can you paste the `ssh -v` output (redact any long hashes)?
Zoe Chen: pasted below:
```
OpenSSH_9.3p1, OpenSSL 3.0.8
debug1: Reading configuration data /home/zoe/.ssh/config
debug1: Offering public key: /home/zoe/.ssh/id_ed25519
debug1: Server accepts key: pkalg ssh-ed25519 somekeyinfo
debug1: Authentications that can continue: publickey
debug1: Next authentication method: publickey
debug1: No more authentication methods available.
Permission denied (publickey).
```
matt-ops: that output usually means your public key isn't registered with Okta. Upload your `id_ed25519.pub` to Okta: Profile -> Security -> SSH keys. Wait ~2 minutes for the sync to our infra. Ping me if it doesn't propagate.
Zoe Chen: Where do I get my pubkey? I only used the phone passkey flow for Okta, didn't create an SSH key yet.
amanda-devex: 1Password/Okta passkeys are for web SSO only — they don't generate system SSH keys. On your laptop run `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "zoe@redwood.com"` and then copy the contents of `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`. That file is the pubkey to upload.
Zoe Chen: doing that now.
it-bot: 1Password seat assigned to Zoe Chen (zoe@redwood.com) — invite accepted.
Zoe Chen: 1Password web shows my vaults, but the `op` CLI returned "membership not found" initially.
matt-ops: run `eval $(op signin --account redwood)` and make sure you use the same email as Okta. If `op` still errors, share the exact message.
Zoe Chen: `op` signin worked after the eval. I uploaded id_ed25519.pub to Okta (SSH keys section). Still get Permission denied when SSHing — bryan, any more checks?
bryan-eng: confirm the key was uploaded to the SSH keys section (not API tokens). Also ensure the pubkey is a single-line entry and not wrapped. Run `ssh -vvv git@bastion.redwood` and paste the last handful of lines here or DM me.
Zoe Chen: sent the verbose output to bryan in DM. Quick side Q: the onboarding doc linked to `drive.google.com/drive/folders/redwood/team/eng` but I don't see it in my Drive.
sarah-it: looks like your Google account provisioned but you're not yet in the `eng-core` group that grants the folder. I'll add you to `eng-core` now.
sarah-it: done — you should get access within ~90s. If not, try logging out/in of Drive.
Zoe Chen: tried logout/login, folder appeared — I can access the onboarding checklist and templates. SSH also works now, thanks team :tada:
amanda-devex: welcome aboard Zoe! If you want, I can DM a short bash script we use to bootstrap dev laptops (dotfiles + recommended packages).
Zoe Chen: please do, that would be awesome. Thanks everyone for the quick help!
